channel.title: Grove Stories: Cozy Bedtime Tales
channel.description:
Short, original, gentle bedtime stories about small creatures in a quiet grove: a seedling who can't wait, a creature who's scared of the dark, a friend who forgets to share. Each one is about three minutes and ends softly, ready for sleep.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Puffgrove: Grove Creatures, an iPhone game where you hatch a little creature, give it a grove and help shape its habits. Puffgrove: Grove Creatures on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
